newFinding.mechanism: C08 state.read awaits namespace authorize after reader callback. Namespace principal/grants do not attest the UI/native lease. Finish, replacement or expiry can leave same principal/Request signal/snapshot. Final synchronous requestFor(context) identity check follows all awaited callbacks and snapshot comparisons.
newFinding.proofScope: Real private UI admission and C08/SQLite provider; controlled authorizer deliberately independent from lease registry. No external business user/native installation claim.
newFinding.writeBoundary: draft may already have committed before lease ends at egress. Refusal suppresses returned case; it does not roll back that durable draft and does not claim write authorization atomicity beyond existing C08 contract.

candidateQualification: New overlay is not qualified by merely adopting source receipts. All historical run SHAs and source scope limitations remain exact; root must attach hosted selected runs and restrict any reuse to observed closure/symbol evidence.
